cases.sentence: Потом я услышал, как Он взывает ___:
cases.explain: «громким голосом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

cases.sentence: Я увидел шестерых мужчин, идущих со стороны ___, что смотрят на север, каждый был со смертоносным оружием в руке.
cases.explain: «верхних ворот» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

cases.explain: «смертоносным оружием» — after the preposition «со», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

cases.sentence: Господь позвал человека, одетого в льняную одежду, у которого на поясе были ___, 4 и сказал ему:
cases.explain: «письменные принадлежности» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

cases.sentence: Тут человек, одетый в льняную одежду, у которого на поясе были ___, вернулся и доложил:
cases.explain: «письменные принадлежности» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”
